checked_obligation: Verify that the prime factors of p-1 can be listed as 2 and odd primes p_1,...,p_k.
reason: Since p=4t+3, p-1=4t+2=2(2t+1), where 2t+1 is odd. Thus 2 is a prime factor of p-1, and every other prime factor is odd; these may be listed as p_1,...,p_k. None of the supplied group-theoretic rules is needed.
